newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India to sell 55,000/T Nov Vizag/Cochin naphtha.
newsitem.headline: India to sell 55,000/T Nov Vizag/Cochin naphtha.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued tenders to sell a total of 55,000 tonnes of naphtha for November lifting from Cochin and Vizag, industry sources said on Monday.

IOC is offering 25,000 tonnes of low aromatic naphtha for November 24-26 lifting on a free-on-board (fob) basis from Vizag on the Indian east coast, and 30,000 tonnes of high aromatic naphtha for November 20-22 lifting fob Cochin on the west coast.
Both tenders will close on November 7 and offers are valid until November 8.
In its last tender, IOC sold 25,000 tonnes high aromatic naphtha to Swiss trader Glencore at $27.47 a tonne below Northwest European quotes for November 14-16 lifting fob Bombay on the west coast.
